name: Premier Paints Plc
source: Premier Paints Plc audited report and financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGX corporate disclosure, quarter 5 filing, March 2026). Statement of cash flows, printed page 40. The statement page carries no text layer, so the page was rendered and read by OCR at 300 dpi and every figure was then checked against the statement arithmetic: the working capital lines sum to the 980 and (1,039) printed as the cash movement, and the 2025 profit for the year of 1,993 agrees with the same figure in the stored income statement.
unit: NGN, printed in thousands and converted to naira
note: The statement prints an investing activities section and a financing activities section with no figure against any line item, for either year, and its net movement of cash equals the operating total to the unit in both years (980 and 1,039 against the same operating subtotal), so both are carried as nil. The statement does not tie to itself by one thousand naira on the cash line: its 2025 opening 942 plus the 980 movement is 1,922 while it prints 1,921 as the closing balance, and the audited statement of financial position prints cash equivalents of 1,921 for 2025 and 942 for 2024. The figures above are the ones the statement prints.
